why_this_package.problem: bm ERAM/prefetch solved the DRAM long line, but the next path is bm_a_rd (ERAM clk2q ~1.5 ns) -> hash3 -> htab_rd_addr(fanout 1409) -> htab_v 1024x1 LUT-RAM read -> htab_rvalid. htab is still 66-bit fabric RAM; moving the write port out of reset alone did not infer ERAM.
why_this_package.solution: Split htab 66-bit entry into ERAM-friendly arrays (v/pos/data), register the read address, remove read-enable/penetration mux from the read process, single no-reset write port; preserve write-first/distance-1.
